name: Disney
hook: The studio that turned fairy tales, music and a mouse into a century of animation.

facts.label: Walt Disney
facts.statement: Walt Disney won four awards at the 1954 Oscars, and he used the alias M.T. Lott to buy 27,000 acres in Florida for Disney World.

facts.label: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
facts.statement: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs was Disney's first animated feature, premiering December 21, 1937, and it earned Walt a special Oscar.

facts.label: Pinocchio
facts.statement: Pinocchio is the 1940 puppet film whose title voice was supplied by Dick Jones; it is in the National Film Registry.

facts.label: Fantasia
facts.statement: Fantasia is the 1940 eight-part marriage of music and animation; Hewlett-Packard's first big customer was Walt Disney, buying sound equipment for it.

facts.label: Dumbo
facts.statement: Dumbo is the 1941 film in which a misfit elephant becomes a circus star with help from Timothy Mouse.

facts.label: Bambi
facts.statement: Bambi opened in 1942 and killed off its mother; in 1944 Smokey Bear replaced Bambi as the U.S. Forest Service symbol.

facts.label: Mary Poppins
facts.statement: Mary Poppins is the musical whose making is dramatized in Saving Mr. Banks; 'Feed the Birds' was one of Walt Disney's favorite songs.
